main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). A tight, turning 1,600m Northern Rivers country oval with a 360m home straight. Sharp bends place a heavy mathematical premium on early tactical speed ('E' and 'P') and ground-saving inside trips on Good/Soft ground.
main_turf.post_bias: INSIDE BARRIER BIAS: In 1100m, 1200m, and 1300m races, inside barriers (stalls 1–4) hold a paramount advantage to secure the rail before the tight first bend. Wide barriers (8+) face severe ground loss around tight turns unless possessing dominant early speed. On Heavy 8 to Heavy 10 bogs, jockey bias shifts wide toward the center of the track on the home bend.

handicapping_angles.tight_turning_on_pace_bias: On firm to soft ground, Lismore strongly favors front-runners ('E') and tactical pressers ('P') that establish early position. Severely downgrade deep closers ('C') who risk getting trapped behind tiring horses on the tight turns.
handicapping_angles.subtropical_wet_track_bog_specialists: Lismore experiences frequent heavy coastal rainfall. On Heavy 8+ tracks, the inside rail deteriorates rapidly. Heavily upgrade horses with proven Soft/Heavy track stats (2+ wins on Heavy ground) and wet-sire pedigrees.
handicapping_angles.se_queensland_border_shippers: Lismore sits near the QLD border and attracts frequent shippers from Gold Coast, Eagle Farm, Murwillumbah, and Grafton. SE QLD Metro/Provincial shippers carrying strong Brisbane form hold a clear class edge over local bush maidens and BM58 handicaps.
handicapping_angles.lismore_cup_showcase_class: During the Lismore Cup Showcase carnival in September, race quality elevates to Provincial/Showcase level. Factor in higher par offsets for Cup day feature races.
